source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of economic disparities (PDF 183).

blocks.text: Digital divide ke maeeshati (economic) asraat bhi bare hain. Aaj ki economy mein bohat si naukriyon ke liye kam az kam basic (bunyadi) digital skills chahiyein. Jin logon ke paas technology ya internet nahi, unhein naukri milna mushkil hota hai, aur pehle se pichhri hui communities mein berozgari (unemployment) aur barh jati hai.

Misal: Pakistan mein online job portals (naukri ki websites) aur digital banking services aksar sirf shehri ilaqon ke logon tak mehdood hain, jis se shehri aur dehi aabadi ke darmiyan maali faasla aur barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek tareeqa bataiye jis se digital divide maali faasla barhata hai.
blocks.explanation: Jis ke paas internet nahi woh online job portals par apply nahi kar sakta aur digital banking istemal nahi kar sakta, is liye woh naukriyon aur maali services se mehroom reh jata hai.

items: Maali farq: naukriyon ke liye digital skills zaroori; online job portals aur digital banking zyada tar shehron tak.
